name: No Thanks!
summary: Players avoid taking numbered cards by paying chips; runs score only their lowest card, chips offset points, lowest total wins.
rules_text: Shuffle cards 3-35 and remove 9 face-down to make a 24-card deck. Each player gets 11 chips, kept hidden in hand. On your turn a card is face-up in the middle with a pool of chips on it. You must either take the card and all chips on it into your tableau, or pay one chip from your hand onto the card and pass clockwise. Taking ends the trick; you then flip the next deck card and decide first. Runs of consecutive numbers in your tableau score only the lowest number of the run. Final score is sum of singletons plus lowest of each run minus remaining chips. Lowest score wins.
rating_reason: Sequential take-or-pay chip decision, perfect bidding game
reasons: dropped: too simple: it is still degenerate or luck-driven: always taking the last option as seat 1 wins 98% of decided matches against random seats (after 3 variation(s))
